authorization.request: Sure, once GTEx data is all set for testing, let's run the current trained frozen model on it to see
authorization.interpretation: Expression download, header freezing, one-time extraction, frozen scoring, and prespecified evaluation are authorized only after this protocol and implementation are committed and pass non-GTEx tests.

claim_limit: GTEx V11 evaluates nominally non-diseased adult human tissue under one harmonized STAR/RNASeQC consortium pipeline and a postmortem or organ-donor collection regime. It is external donor-controlled domain-shift evidence, not multisource cross-study confirmation and not evidence from clinically healthy living donors.

implementation.whole_suite_note: The repository-wide pytest collection remains blocked by the pre-existing ModuleNotFoundError for preprocessing in tests/test_extract_manifest_expression.py; all GTEx, intake, and frozen-candidate tests pass.

counts_object.name: GTEx_Analysis_2026-05-19_v11_RNASeQCv2.4.3_gene_reads.gct.gz
counts_object.description: Gene read counts from RNASeQCv2.4.3 with LCM samples excluded
counts_object.verification: Exact size and prebound GCS CRC32C are required before any GCT header or value is accepted; SHA256 is computed locally and propagated after download.

historical_overlap_result.conclusion: The global four-donor exclusion seals GTEx/EN-TEx overlap across the complete historical ARCHS4 v11 catalog, not only the Stage-1 subset.

model.fallback: adipose uses the frozen pooled trunk

header_freeze.read_scope: Only GCT version, dimensions, and sample-ID header before the cohort artifact is sealed.
header_freeze.membership_rule: Intersect the 7,845 metadata-selected rows with the exact pinned GCT header, requiring every header-present row to have the official GTEx SMAFRZE=RNASEQ flag and every header-absent row to have SMAFRZE=EXCLUDE. Any exception, missing flag, or duplicate ID is a technical failure; effect-informed replacement or rescue is forbidden.

header_only_resolution_before_values.official_flag_separation: All 6,795 header-present provisional rows are SMAFRZE=RNASEQ and all 1,050 absent provisional rows are SMAFRZE=EXCLUDE.

header_freeze.order: Lexicographic sample_id order inherited from the provisional cohort after exact header membership validation.

expression.input: RNASeQC raw gene read counts in GCT 1.2
expression.gene_mapping: Strip the version suffix from GCT Name stable Ensembl gene IDs and map uniquely through the official GENCODE V49 gene record to its V49 symbol; use exact GCT Description only when the stable ID has no V49 record. Aggregate all source rows reaching the same candidate symbol.
expression.duplicate_symbols: Sum counts for all source rows deterministically mapped to the same V49 candidate symbol before QC or normalization.
expression.missing_score_genes: The exact ten structurally absent RNASeQC rows are zero-filled as model inputs, remain masked with the complete original 4,634-gene target panel, and are excluded from every target metric. Any different absent score-gene set is a technical failure.
expression.qc_universe: All unique GCT Description symbols present in the frozen GENCODE v49 exon-length table, after duplicate-symbol aggregation and before canonical reindexing.
normalization: divide each canonical gene count by frozen exon length in kilobases
sum rates over the 15,448 canonical genes only
scale canonical rates to one million
expression.log_transform: No log transform in extraction; the frozen scorer applies log1p exactly once.

attempt_1.stop_reason: Exact-symbol mapping left six renamed and ten structurally absent score genes unresolved.

technical_retry_ledger.allowed_retry: One deterministic extraction retry is allowed solely with the checksum-bound stable-ID mapping and exact frozen unavailable-gene set above; there remains exactly one model-scoring access.

expression.pipeline_shift: GTEx STAR/RNASeQC versus ARCHS4 Kallisto is an intended robustness dimension and is not described as preprocessing equivalence.

aggregation_order: average the three prespecified model-seed metrics within sample
average all retained samples or tissue sites within donor and organ
give equal donor mass within organ
give equal mass to all five organs
estimand.uncertainty: Paired global-donor bootstrap; sampling donors globally preserves cross-organ donor correlation, and the vanishingly rare draw missing an organ is rejected.
estimand.tissue_site_results: diagnostic only and unavailable for selection or rescue

metrics.primary: mean squared error over the 4,624 externally available members of the 4,634-gene frozen target-hidden score panel in log1p TPM space
metrics.secondary: per-sample Pearson correlation between predicted and observed residuals from the development-refit-only organ-specific mean log1p score-gene baseline
metrics.router: frozen target-hidden five-class organ router; all original 4,634 target genes are masked, including the ten unavailable rows; predicted adipose dispatches pooled

controls.pooled_adapter: frozen one-adapter residual-capacity control for each training seed
controls.assigned_random_algorithm: For each partition seed and organ, hash-rank unique donor IDs by SHA256 of partition_seed NUL organ NUL donor_id, break exact hash ties by donor_id, then assign rank modulo four; every sample in a donor-organ unit shares the label and expert donor counts differ by at most one.
controls.mapped_random: Apply the frozen organ router, then the development-only organ-to-expert mapping stored for that random partition; predicted adipose dispatches pooled.
controls.multiple_testing: Holm adjustment separately across the three assigned-random comparisons and the three mapped-random comparisons.

acceptance_gates.blind_k4_vs_pooled: relative MSE reduction >= 3%, donor-bootstrap absolute-improvement CI lower bound > 0, and residual-Pearson gain CI lower bound > 0
acceptance_gates.true_k4_vs_pooled: relative MSE reduction >= 3% and donor-bootstrap absolute-improvement CI lower bound > 0
acceptance_gates.true_k4_vs_each_assigned_random: relative MSE reduction >= 3%, absolute-improvement CI lower bound > 0, and Holm-adjusted one-sided p <= 0.05 for all three partitions
acceptance_gates.blind_k4_vs_each_mapped_random: relative MSE reduction > 0, absolute-improvement CI lower bound > 0, and Holm-adjusted one-sided p <= 0.05 for all three partitions
acceptance_gates.router_recovery: blind absolute MSE improvement divided by true-dispatch absolute MSE improvement >= 0.80
acceptance_gates.seed_stability: true and blind relative MSE reductions are positive for every training seed and each across-seed sample SD is <= 0.5 times its mean
acceptance_gates.active_organ_safety: true-dispatch point MSE effect versus pooled is nonnegative separately in brain, liver, skeletal muscle, and skin

decision_precedence: technical_fail if provenance, checksum, alignment, membership, gene coverage, QC, completeness, or finite-value checks fail
no_external_gain if the true-K4-versus-pooled gate fails
generic_capacity_or_partition_fail if any random-control or pooled-adapter gate fails
router_bottleneck if blind-versus-pooled or router-recovery fails after true dispatch and controls pass
full_external_pass if every acceptance gate passes

retention.allowed: sealed cohort metadata, canonical TPM extraction, compact per-sample MSE and residual-Pearson metrics, reports, hashes, and logs
retention.forbidden: serialization of full GTEx target or prediction vectors by the scorer
